1.w: A psalm of David. Here is the Lord’s proclamation to my lord: “Sit down at my right hand until I make your enemies your footstool.”

2.w: The Lord extends your dominion from Zion. Rule in the midst of your enemies.

3.w: Your people willingly follow you when you go into battle. On the holy hills at sunrise the dew of your youth belongs to you.

4.w: The Lord makes this promise on oath and will not revoke it: “You are an eternal priest after the pattern of Melchizedek.”

5.w: O Lord, at your right hand he strikes down kings in the day he unleashes his anger.

6.w: He executes judgment against the nations. He fills the valleys with corpses; he shatters their heads over the vast battlefield.

7.w: From the stream along the road he drinks; then he lifts up his head.
